output.missingRisk: This session focuses on garbage disposal care, utensil holder organization, granite countertop scratch repair, a leaky faucet, and making yogurt in a slow cooker (including non-dairy yogurt and thickening agents). It does not directly provide general “keep the kitchen clean” tips; the only cleanliness-adjacent items are about removing food residue/debris and cleaning specific kitchen components.

claims.fact: Clean your utensil holder regularly: remove any food residue or debris from your utensil holder to prevent bacteria growth and keep your kitchen clean.
claims.why: Provides a cleanliness-maintenance action relevant to preventing kitchen mess.

claims.fact: Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, or acidic substances on your granite countertop, as they can damage the surface.
claims.why: Helps maintain/clean granite safely, reducing risk of damage that can worsen mess/maintenance needs.

claims.fact: Use coasters and pads under objects that can scratch the surface, such as pots, pans, and utensils.
claims.why: Prevention tip to reduce future countertop marks/scratches that contribute to the kitchen looking messy.

claims.fact: Always use a cutting board when preparing food to prevent knives from scratching the countertop.
claims.why: Prevention tip related to keeping surfaces cleaner and less scarred.

claims.fact: Turn off the water supply: Always turn off the water supply to the faucet before attempting any repairs to prevent water damage or flooding.
claims.why: Advice to prevent water leaks/messes from spreading while fixing kitchen plumbing.

claims.fact: Choose an unsweetened milk to avoid added sugars and control the flavor.
claims.why: Food-prep parameter that can reduce cleanup issues from unexpected sweetness/spoilage risks (indirectly relevant to keeping kitchen manageable).
